description: Businesses of one category across a US city, ZIP or coordinates, radius up to 20 km: name, address, phone, website, social links, distance, confidence and source for each. Nearest first, up to 150 per call, paged with offset (see total_found and next_offset). Same data as nearby-businesses, built for lists. Charged only when at least one is found. Costs $0.25 per call (x402).

offset.description: skip this many (for the next page), default 0

place.description: US city and state, or ZIP (or give lat and lon)

name: area_businesses
